title: Radio-Controlled Drift Car 1:24 4WD – Track and Extra Tires Included
seo_title: Radio-Controlled Drift Car 1:24 – Track and Extra Tires Included
seo_description: Radio-controlled drift car in 1:24 scale with 4WD and LED lights. 5 cones, 2 barrels and 4 extra drift tires come with it – a track is included right in the box.
descriptionHtml:
Remote-controlled cars that only drive straight ahead

Most remote-controlled cars do one thing – drive in a straight line until the battery runs out. No track, no obstacles, nothing to slide around. After a week the car sits in a box, because there was nothing more to do with it.

A car built to slide, with a track in the box

The car is built in 1:24 scale with 4WD and LED lights, and is controlled with a pistol-grip controller. In the box come 5 cones and 2 barrels to lay out as a track, plus 4 extra drift tires for when the first ones are worn. The top speed is 20 km/h.

Features

  • You get started without hunting for obstacles – 5 cones and 2 barrels come in the box.
  • Four extra tires ready when the first ones are worn – 4 extra drift tires are included in the package.
  • More grip in the corners – 4WD according to the packaging drives all four wheels.
  • Visible even at dusk – the car has LED lights.
  • Controlled with a grip made for quick turns – pistol-grip controller included.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
